comment: Colours every HST icon is built with (hst, hst_dark, hst_modern*, the Cổ điển overlay), so HST glyphs read as part of the Colibre set they stand beside. Keys are palette.json tokens; 'fill' paints areas (pale Colibre tints), 'line' paints coloured strokes and state bars (Colibre's stronger accents). Each value is [light, dark]; 'none' leaves the area unpainted, as Colibre's dark icons leave their paper. Ink (currentColor) is metadata/ink.json.
